an ordinary exclusion raises no network-fixes notice

stopping the recording clears returning and off-track state

staying on track never delivers an alert

stopping clears active state and the poll loop stops scheduling further work
going off-track delivers exactly one alert, not one per fix

starting a recording collects live fixes and updates returnToStart reactively, without a direct call
startReturn is a no-op with nothing recording

moving steadily away from the start while returning sets off-track
